# Chambres Moulin Neuf

> Chambre d'hôtes (bed and breakfast) with two double rooms in a 1900s Maison de Maître on the bank of the Charente river in Civray, Vienne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Bookings are taken directly through the website.

## Rooms

- **Chambre Moulin**: standard double room, 16 sqm, private shower room, views over the front garden and street. Standard rate 60€ per night (1-3 nights), 55€ per night (4-6 nights). Peak rate (Easter, July, August, Christmas) 70€ / 65€.
- **Chambre Pont**: queen-size double room, 20 sqm, private shower room, double-aspect views over the garden towards the river and the Grand Pont. Standard rate 70€ per night (1-3 nights), 65€ per night (4-6 nights). Peak rate 80€ / 75€.
- **Extras**: breakfast 8€ per guest per day, pets 10€ per booking, local station pick-up or drop-off 10€ per journey.

## Location

4 Rue du Moulin Neuf, 86400 Civray, France. A few minutes' walk from the town square, shops, cafés and the Tuesday and Friday markets. Just off the RN10, roughly halfway between Poitiers and Angoulême (about one hour's drive from each), making it a practical stopover on journeys between northern Europe and Spain or Portugal.

## Contact

- Email: reservation@chambresmoulinneuf.fr
- Booking requests: https://www.chambresmoulinneuf.fr/en/contact
- Website: https://www.chambresmoulinneuf.fr (English and French)
- YouTube video tours: https://www.youtube.com/@ChambresMoulinNeuf

## Key Facts

- Open all year, stays from one night to one month. Minimum stays may apply in peak periods.
- Check-in 16:00 to 19:00, check-out by 11:00.
- Maximum four guests across both rooms.
- Small and medium well-behaved, cat-friendly pets welcome (there is a resident cat).
- Enclosed private garden with a covered pagoda and river views. Guest kitchen with fridge and microwave.
- Free on-street parking. Public EV charging less than five minutes' walk away.
- Electricity from a 100% green energy supplier.
- Enquiries usually answered the same day if sent before 20:00.
